_note: Ground-level litter/trash detection sets for litter AI v2. fetch_extra_data.py reads this file. 'workspace' and 'project' are the two parts of the Roboflow Universe URL (universe.roboflow.com/<workspace>/<project>). The licence is re-read from the Roboflow API at fetch time; a set is skipped unless it is on allowed_licences. Candidates come from a Universe search and were NOT opened by hand: run `python fetch_extra_data.py --list` first and check the printed image counts and class names.
_version_note: version null = the highest version number the API lists.

_skipped.pLitterStreet (Zenodo 8288500, CC BY 4.0: images.zip is 13.7 GB and the photos are vehicle-mounted street views with tiny, distant items: far from a C920 close-up, too heavy for a 4 GB laptop run.
_skipped.MJU-Waste: RGB-D indoor set hosted on a personal drive link, licence not stated in the review: skipped (no clear licence).
_skipped.RoLID-11K: dashcam road views with tiny items; repository is Apache 2.0 but the image licence is not stated: skipped.
_skipped.SWiM3: research and educational use only: skipped.
_skipped.Cigarette butt dataset: non-commercial educational licence and synthetic images: skipped.
_skipped.Domestic Trash Dataset: paid licence, 250 free images only: skipped.
_skipped.garbage_detection (Roboflow, ourouba): labels whole garbage piles, not single items: skipped.
_skipped.BeachLitter, BePLi v2, UAVVaste, TrashCa: beach, aerial, underwater or conveyor-belt scenes: not the park/street/floor/indoor look we need (BePLi v1 is already in).
_skipped.rf_roads, rf_c64nk, rf_i8tin (Roboflow): HTTP 404: project not found with the API (removed or private).
